blurb: Eagle Park Brewing Company produces over 440 beers with specialty ingredients, maintaining freshness by selling some beers only at the brewery and recommending refrigeration. They host Quizmaster Trivia events at Muskego and Hamilton locations with a $1 per player cost and prizes for winners. Their beers are distributed in several states, with spirits only in Wisconsin.
extraNote: Cost is $1 per player, payable to the trivia host
